Class LlamaBlock

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.model.llama.LlamaBlock
public class LlamaBlock extends Object
A Llama dense-decoder block: grouped-query attention followed by a SwiGLU feed-forward network, each with a residual connection and RMSNorm.

  • Constructor Details

    • LlamaBlock

      public LlamaBlock(int layerId, int dim, int numHeads, int numKvHeads, Integer intermediateSize, int multipleOf, Double ffnDimMultiplier, double normEps)
      Constructor. The attention module receives its KvCachePool later via LlamaModel.setKvCachePool(KvCachePool).
      Parameters:
      layerId - the identifier of the block.
      dim - token embedding dimension.
      numHeads - number of query heads.
      numKvHeads - number of key/value heads.
      intermediateSize - explicit FFN hidden size, or null to derive it.
      multipleOf - FFN rounding multiple when intermediateSize is null.
      ffnDimMultiplier - optional FFN dim multiplier when deriving size.
      normEps - RMSNorm epsilon.

    • LlamaBlock

      public LlamaBlock(int layerId, int dim, int numHeads, int numKvHeads, Integer intermediateSize, int multipleOf, Double ffnDimMultiplier, double normEps, KvCacheLayout layout)
      Convenience constructor that allocates a private test-sized KV pool.
      Parameters:
      layerId - the identifier of the block.
      dim - token embedding dimension.
      numHeads - number of query heads.
      numKvHeads - number of key/value heads.
      intermediateSize - explicit FFN hidden size, or null.
      multipleOf - FFN rounding multiple when deriving size.
      ffnDimMultiplier - optional FFN dim multiplier.
      normEps - RMSNorm epsilon.
      layout - cache layout for the private test pool.
